lines.text:
Shh! Listen, I need to share a
secret with someone.\c
I think that this chunk of amber
contains Pokémon DNA!\c
It would be a shattering scientific
breakthrough if Pokémon could be
resurrected from it.\c
But my colleagues just ignore
what I have to say.\c
So I have a favor to ask!\c
I want you to get this examined at
a Pokémon Lab somewhere.

What’s this? Could it be you resurrected that
Aerodactyl from the amber?!\c
Oh, thank you! You’ve proven that my
hypothesis was correct!
DNA is so amazing!\nYou should study it, too!
